stepper_preview_description: Try the steps or use Previous and Continue. The host controls navigation; the stepper never saves a form.
stepper_preview_content: Your project supplies the content, validation and saving behavior for this step.
stepper_example_form_description: Enter a project name, review it, then confirm. Previous skips validation and keeps your draft. This demo does not save data.
stepper_example_finished: Review complete. Nothing was sent or saved; your draft stays available until you leave this page.
stepper_example_vertical_description: A vertical layout with descriptions and explicit states, without navigation controls or numbered indicators.
notifications_staff_description: Read-only access to existing email deliveries within your authorized scopes. Acceptance is not confirmed delivery or reading.
notifications_staff_feedback_notice: Confirmation and bounce counts cover only deliveries with configured provider feedback. Unavailable feedback is not evidence of successful delivery or zero bounces. Contact association does not establish feedback coverage. Consent and suppression management remain separate.
kraksend_ops_description: Installation email activity, refreshed every 15 seconds. Dates use ISO timestamps with timezone; end is exclusive. Delivery statistics use publication time; pending feedback uses receipt time. Active suppressions are current and unfiltered. Acceptance is not confirmed delivery or reading.
kraksend_ops_suppression_warning: Blocks apply independently of consent, including transactional email. Removing a block does not subscribe a contact or resend messages. Review bounce/complaint evidence before unblocking. Every change requires an audit reason.
kraksend_ops_recipients_hint: Open a campaign's recipients, or enter its campaign ID above, to inspect pending, published and skipped recipients.
kraksend_ops_failed: The operation failed. Refresh and review the latest data before retrying; a suppression may have changed.
kraksend_campaign_description: Schedule bilingual email for a snapshot of subscribed contacts. Completed means publication finished, not delivery confirmed.
kraksend_campaign_cancel_description: Pending messages will be blocked. Messages already accepted by the provider cannot be recalled.
kraksend_unsubscribe_description: Stop optional email for this contact in this application. Essential emails, such as password resets, will continue.
kraksend_unsubscribe_invalid: This unsubscribe link is invalid or has expired.
kraksend_unsubscribe_unavailable: We could not save your choice. Please try again.
kraksend_unsubscribe_success: You have unsubscribed from optional email for this application.
kraksend_contacts_description: Manage recipients for this application. Creating a contact does not subscribe it to optional email.
kraksend_contacts_failed: We could not complete this operation. Please try again.
color_picker_preview_description: Enter a HEX code or click the swatch to choose a color visually.
notification_unsubscribe_description: Stop all optional notification emails for your account across all organizations and workspaces. Password resets and other essential emails will continue. In-app notifications will not change.
notification_unsubscribe_success: You have unsubscribed from optional email notifications.
notification_unsubscribe_invalid: This unsubscribe link is invalid or has expired. Use a link from a more recent email or manage notifications in your account.
notification_unsubscribe_unavailable: We could not save your unsubscribe request. Please try again later.
agent_preview_demo_description: Choose a scenario, then open the assistant. All tool calls and responses are simulated; no data is read or changed. Try @ references, removing context, stopping a response, minimizing, maximizing, and closing to reset.
agent_preview_tool_description: Simulated tool call using sample data only. No external service is contacted.
agent_preview_tools_response: I found 3 matching resources and read the onboarding guide. It contains 4 sections: introduction, setup, first task, and next steps. I'd recommend adding a short checklist to the setup section. These results are simulated.
agent_preview_tool_failure_response: The search succeeded, but reading the guide failed in this simulation. You can try the tool chain demo again, or provide another resource with @. No data was changed.
agent_preview_approved_response: Approved! The simulated action completed successfully. In a connected application, the tool result would now be available to the assistant. No real data was changed.
agent_preview_denied_response: Cancelled. I won't carry out that action. You can send a different request or choose another demo. No data was changed.
agent_preview_markdown_response: Here's a formatted response with a code example you can copy.
agent_preview_markdown_item: Use references to give the assistant relevant context. This example is illustrative and does not execute any code.
agent_preview_response_intro: Hello! This is a simulated assistant response—no AI service is connected. I can help you explore the widget, draft a plan, or work with a reference. Try typing @ to select a resource.
agent_preview_response_plan:
Here's a sample plan:

1. Define the goal and gather the relevant resources.
2. Break the work into small, reviewable steps.
3. Review the result before making any changes.

In a connected application, the assistant could use tools to carry out these steps.
agent_preview_response_followup: Ready for the next step? Add more detail to your request, or mention a resource with @. This preview only simulates replies; it doesn't read or change any data.
agent_preview_response_references: You've attached these references: {references}. In a connected application, I could use them to tailor my answer. For this demo, imagine a summary of the key points followed by suggested next steps. No resource data has been accessed.
data_table_preview_kitchen_sink_descript: Custom cells, grouping, selection, row actions, reordering, gallery view, and export in one table.
data_table_preview_column_types_descript: Each column demonstrates its named type, including empty values. Date-times use UTC. Lists can display names or icons. Toggle a boolean or open an editable list to add and remove members.
error_preview_description: Copy a sample error report or try a full page refresh. The home link returns to the site homepage.
error_preview_message: We couldn't load this example. Try refreshing the page, or copy the error details to share with support.
registry_search_description: Search registry items and open their documentation.
home_title: Ship the hard parts of your app
home_description: Install production-ready UI, Effect services, and developer tooling with shadcn, or import the package directly. Own the code, keep your architecture, and move from setup to product faster.
home_open_source_note: Open source, type-safe, and built to live in your codebase.
home_capabilities_title: A better starting point without another framework
home_capabilities_description: Use focused building blocks instead of rebuilding the same application surface for every project.
home_capability_install_description: Install focused components and services through shadcn, import the package directly, or review every line and change anything.
home_capability_stack_description: Use coherent TanStack, Effect, Drizzle, and shadcn patterns across the browser, API, and database.
home_capability_agents_description: Give coding agents documented patterns, MCP-enabled APIs, and reusable building blocks they can work with safely.
home_platform_title: The pieces stay aligned from interface to infrastructure.
home_platform_ui_description: Accessible shadcn components, forms, tables, previews, and layouts ready to shape into your product.
home_platform_backend_description: Typed services, HTTP APIs, OpenAPI metadata, persistence, and observability patterns that belong together.
home_platform_agents_description: Documentation, MCP, CLI, and AI helpers give your team and coding agents a shared vocabulary.
home_platform_source_description: Import the package for a fast start or copy registry source when you want full ownership. Either way, the architecture stays visible and yours to extend.
home_sites_description: See the same patterns composed into a working application, then use the registry to bring only what you need into your own codebase.
home_repositories_description: Start with a complete application, add production-ready authentication, or run a focused uptime monitor. Each repository is open source and ready to adapt.
home_repository_template_description: A full-stack TanStack Start template with Effect services, Drizzle persistence, shadcn UI, and production-ready application patterns.
home_repository_auth_description: A reusable Better Auth implementation with organizations, sessions, API keys, and typed Effect integration.
home_repository_uptime_description: A lightweight status page and uptime monitor with health history, incident alerts, and a responsive public dashboard.
home_cta_title: Start with the architecture, finish with your product.
home_cta_description: Browse the introduction, install a focused block or import the package, and keep moving with code you can inspect and adapt.
home_stats_components_description: Registry UI blocks ready to install with shadcn.
home_stats_total_description: Components, services, libraries, and configuration starters.
home_catalogue_title: Start with a block. Keep building from there.
home_catalogue_description: Choose only what your application needs. Every registry item includes source, dependencies, usage guidance, and a path to customization.
home_footer_note: Open-source building blocks for ambitious TanStack apps.
krakstack_site_template_description: A live full-stack TanStack Start template showing the app patterns, UI blocks, Effect services, Drizzle database setup, i18n, and CRUD reference implementation.
krakstack_site_template_overview: template.krakstack.net is the hosted preview of the KrakStack starter app. Use it to see how the template behaves before cloning the source or installing registry items into your own application.
krakstack_site_template_feature_start: TanStack Start routing and server rendering in a working application shell.
krakstack_site_template_feature_effect: Effect HTTP APIs, OpenAPI documentation, service layers, and Drizzle/PostgreSQL persistence.
krakstack_site_template_feature_state: shadcn UI components, forms, tables, and optimistic Effect Atom client state.
krakstack_site_template_feature_i18n: Paraglide English/French i18n and localized routing patterns.
pagination_preview_description: Controlled page navigation with page-size selection, result summaries, and responsive layouts.
file_picker_preview_document_description: Drop a PDF or text file, or open the native file dialog.
file_picker_preview_image_description: Selected images use a managed local preview URL.
file_picker_preview_multiple_description: Choose several documents at once or add more files to the current selection.
virtualized_combobox_preview_description: Search 1,000 options while only rendering the visible rows.
virtualized_combobox_preview_multiple_de: Select several cities and clear the entire selection at once.
